description: TUM2TWIN publishes semantic building geometry for its Munich campus environment using the OGC CityGML standard. Native documentation distinguishes manually modelled LoD3 buildings with detailed facades and LoD2 buildings with manually added terrestrial textures. The detailed geometry derives from official LoD2 building models and mobile laser-scanning observations. Related CAD representations use SketchUp projects and can be exported to OBJ or PLY; these format variants are grouped with the underlying building geometry. The page also links deprecated initial textured models and official Bavarian LoD2 tiles, which are retained as distinct provenance references. Public descriptive access is free. Exact dataset-specific reuse terms, file access conditions and complete acquisition dates were not established, so a licence is not inherited automatically from the upstream cadastre. Caveats include mixed levels of detail, manual modelling and deprecated component versions. These site-level buildings provide geometry for the TUM2TWIN digital twin and relate to the aggregate benchmark. No CityGML files, CAD models, archives or command examples were executed or retrieved.
